markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (54%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Benign (43%) stays in the 90% set [F1], input reliability is flagged, and frozen-section margins are deferred [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 54%, Benign 43%, Invasive 3%, Normal 0% | Split between InSitu and Benign |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target coverage, alpha 0.10) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.31 reliability (flagged) / 92nd percentile OOD [F6] | Suspect input; atypical vs training |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top classes disagree) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%); 1/5 Benign [F5] | Neighbors mostly support InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (-0.21) pushes toward invasion; 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (-0.54) pushes toward invasion; 20/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.15) pushes away from invasion; 19/20 spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · High score (+1.34) pushes away from invasion; 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Elevated score (+0.75); separates case from Benign contrast neighbor · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.001, 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Frozen-section artifact or out-of-distribution appearance (92nd percentile) distorts the close InSitu (54%) versus Benign (43%) split.
- Region 10 (72% tile risk) or unsampled deeper tissue harbors focal invasion or atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 10, 4, 11**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (72%, 22%, 10% risk) for invasion and deferred lateral/inferior margins.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 7**: Compare duct-confined atypia against benign hyperplasia; review drafted deeper levels order.
3. **Regions 9, 0**: Verify stroma, lobules, and TILs; consider drafted recut H&E section for quality.
